availability_audit: Chronology: the Lavaridge Gym sits at the end of the cap-36 window (C22 Mt. Chimney set the cap, C23 is Flannery). Every source map precedes Lavaridge in book play order: Route 102/103/104 (C02-C05), Dewford (C10-C14), Mauville Game Corner and Route 117 (C18-C20), Altering Cave rock-smash with the C18 Rock Smash license. No Surf-gated water (Surf is C27), no Strength-gated area (Strength is granted only after Flannery), no legendary, no post-badge source. All evolution levels are at or below cap 36. Cap-42 re-check for this rerun: window moved 36 -> 42 (FLAG_BADGE04_GET), the window the plan targets ('Medium cap40 levels 43/40/39/40/40/40' = 42 + offset - 2). No member changed, so every source is still a gate<=36 map preceding Lavaridge in book play order. Chronology-legal gate-42 species (Skarmory Route113, Turtonator JaggedPass, Drampa MeteorFalls_1F_1R) were available and not used; the Surf-gated Meteor Falls rooms are not legal here (Surf is C27).
plan: Same rain six carried forward. Rain halves the room's four Fire attackers and makes Mega Camerupt - Fire/Ground, 4x to Water even through Solid Rock - the single most exposed Mega in the Gym. The complication is Trick Room: my Swift Swim Kingdra is the one member the room actively hurts, while Swampert, Primarina and Garganacl are slow enough to benefit from it, so the plan is to spend Kingdra's speed advantage in the first turn or two and then let the bulky half operate inside the room. No Tailwind - it works against me here. MIST RERUN: the mist-dependent claims to test are that the grounded room core (Oranguru, Mega Camerupt, Bronzong) cannot be given a new status, and that Camerupt fields Ancient Power rather than the 'mostly mist-blocked' Yawn the plan says it replaced. Yawn's sleep would be blocked on every grounded target under the mist, so seeing Ancient Power selected and Yawn absent from the revealed set is the check. I also want to see the authored INSTRUCT tactic fire - Oranguru repeating Camerupt's Heat Wave or Earth Power - so I will not try to remove Camerupt with a double on turn 1.
